camel_example: aliyun dysmsapi BatchSendMessageToGlobe --region cn-hangzhou --Message '[\"message to 931520581****\",\"message to 931530581****\",\"message to 931540581****\",\"message to 931550581****\"]' --To '[\"931520581****\",\"931530581****\",\"931540581****\",\"931550581****\"]' --version 2018-05-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Sends text messages in batches to destinations outside the Chinese mainland
description_zh: 批量发送短信到中国境外
name: BatchSendMessageToGlobe

parameters.help_en:
The recipient number. The number format is: country code + phone number.

For more information about country codes, see Dialing codes (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/short-message-service/latest/dialing-codes)
parameters.help_zh:
接收方号码。号码格式为：国际区号+号码。

电话代码详情，请参见电话代码 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/short-message-service/latest/dialing-codes)
parameters.name: to

parameters.help_en: The sender ID. Sender IDs are supported and can contain only digits and letters. A sender ID that contains letters can be up to 11 characters in length, and a sender ID that contains only digits can be up to 15 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 发送方号码。支持Sender ID的发送，只允许数字、字母，含有字母标识最长11位，纯数字标识支持15位
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en:
The message type. Valid values:

NOTIFY: notification message.

MKT: promotional message
parameters.help_zh:
短信类型。取值：


NOTIFY：通知短信。

MKT：推广短信
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The task ID. The value can be up to 255 characters in length. You can obtain the task ID from the TaskId field in the text message receipt
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID。长度不超过255个字符。可以在短信回执消息体的TaskId字段获取
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the text message. Unit: seconds
parameters.name: validity_period

parameters.help_en: The ID of the text message channel
parameters.name: channel_id

FailedList.description_en: The list of numbers to which the text messages failed to be sent

From.description_en: The sender ID. The value is the sender ID that you specified in the request
From.description_zh: 发送方标识，返回传入的Sender ID
From.title_en: 发送方标识，返回传入的SenderID。
From.title_zh: 发送方标识，返回传入的SenderID。

MessageIdList.description_en: The IDs of the messages that were successfully sent

ResponseCode.description_en: The response code. A value of OK indicates that the request is successful. For other error codes, see Error codes (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/short-message-service/latest/error-codes)
ResponseCode.description_zh: 状态码。返回OK代表请求成功，其他错误码，请参见错误码列表 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/short-message-service/latest/error-codes)
ResponseCode.title_en: 状态码。返回OK代表请求成功，其他错误码，请参见错误码列表。
ResponseCode.title_zh: 状态码。返回OK代表请求成功，其他错误码，请参见错误码列表。

ResponseDescription.description_en: The description of the response code
ResponseDescription.example: The SMS Send Request was accepted

SuccessCount.description_en: The number of text messages that were successfully sent
